name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a plumbing fixture?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a plumbing fixture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a plumbing fixture involves fixing a specific problem, such as replacing a washer in a leaky faucet or clearing a clog in a toilet. Replacement means removing the old fixture entirely and installing a brand new one. Repair is often cost-effective for minor issues or newer fixtures, while replacement is advisable for extensive damage, outdated models, or chronic problems. Alpha-Plumbing Services can help you determine whether repair or replacement is the more economical and practical solution for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing fixes a specific issue, while replacing involves installing a new fixture. Choose based on problem severity, fixture age, and cost-effectiveness.
